## Problem Statement

What architectural problem or ambiguity should be resolved?

## Robotics Use Case

Which robot, simulator, runtime, deployment, or autonomy workflow motivates this discussion?

## ML / Physical AI Relevance

How does this affect datasets, replay, policy inference, imitation learning, VLA workflows, GPU-centered inference, or evaluation?

## Runtime Implications

How does this affect runtime graphs, lifecycle, time, frames, schemas, transports, observability, or safety boundaries?

## ROS2 Interoperability Implications

How does this affect ROS2 topics, services, actions, tf2, rosbag2, MCAP, DDS, Nav2, Autoware, or migration strategy?

## Proposed Direction

Describe the proposed design or decision.

## Tradeoffs

What does this improve, what does it make harder, and what assumptions does it introduce?

## Alternatives Considered

List relevant alternatives and why they may or may not fit RoMi.

## Open Questions

What still needs investigation before implementation?
